newsitem.title: USA: Court upholds Hyperion 1997 suit dismissal.
newsitem.headline: Court upholds Hyperion 1997 suit dismissal.

text.p: Hyperion 1997 Term Trust Inc said Thursday a court of appeals upheld the New York District Court's dismissal of a class action suit against three closed-end funds managed by Hyperion Capital Management Inc.
The funds were Hyperion 1997 Term Trust Inc, Hyperion 1999 Term Trust Inc and Hyperion 2002 Term Trust inc.

The class action suit had alleged securities fraud, Hyperion said. The appeals court affirmed the N.Y. District Court's dismissal of the of plaintiffs second amended complaint with prejudice, Hyperion said. The court cited failure to identify any misrepresentation in the funds' offering material, Hyperion said.
